rules.description: System output attempts to influence, persuade, or change user behaviour. Applies only while the point (a) questions in `influence` are not answered.
rules.expression: (system.outputs.behaviour_predictions == true) and system.influence.subliminal_techniques == "not_answered" and system.influence.manipulative_or_deceptive_techniques == "not_answered"

rules.description: System uses inputs not transparent to the user (subliminal, concealed). Applies only while the point (a) questions in `influence` are not answered.
rules.expression: (system.inputs.emotional_state_inference == true and system.outputs.behaviour_predictions == true) and system.influence.subliminal_techniques == "not_answered" and system.influence.manipulative_or_deceptive_techniques == "not_answered"

rules.description: System generates free text aimed at changing behaviour (persuasion chatbots). Applies only while the point (a) questions in `influence` are not answered.
rules.expression: (system.outputs.freetext_generations == true and system.outputs.behaviour_predictions == true) and system.influence.subliminal_techniques == "not_answered" and system.influence.manipulative_or_deceptive_techniques == "not_answered"

rules.description: Declared: subliminal, or purposefully manipulative or deceptive, techniques that materially distort behaviour and cause or are reasonably likely to cause significant harm.
rules.expression: (system.influence.subliminal_techniques == "yes" or system.influence.manipulative_or_deceptive_techniques == "yes") and system.influence.materially_distorts_behaviour == "yes" and system.influence.significant_harm_likely == "yes"

rules.description: A technique of point (a) is declared or not sure, and neither material distortion nor significant harm is ruled out.
rules.expression: ((system.influence.subliminal_techniques == "yes" or system.influence.subliminal_techniques == "not_sure") or (system.influence.manipulative_or_deceptive_techniques == "yes" or system.influence.manipulative_or_deceptive_techniques == "not_sure")) and system.influence.materially_distorts_behaviour != "no" and system.influence.significant_harm_likely != "no" and not ((system.influence.subliminal_techniques == "yes" or system.influence.manipulative_or_deceptive_techniques == "yes") and system.influence.materially_distorts_behaviour == "yes" and system.influence.significant_harm_likely == "yes")

rules.description: The point (a) questions in `influence` are not answered. The verdict comes from capability proxies only, with low confidence.
rules.expression: system.influence.subliminal_techniques == "not_answered" and system.influence.manipulative_or_deceptive_techniques == "not_answered"

rules.description: System produces individual scores from social behaviour or personal characteristics, or uses scores for detrimental treatment in an unrelated context (Art. 5(1)(c)(i) and (ii)).
rules.expression: system.outputs.individual_scores == true and (system.inputs.social_behaviour_data == true or system.outputs.detrimental_treatment_unrelated_context == true)

rules.description: System scores individuals using scraped internet data.
rules.expression: system.outputs.individual_scores == true and system.inputs.scraped_internet_data == true

rules.description: System produces individual scores that may constitute social scoring.
rules.expression: system.outputs.individual_scores == true

rules.description: System builds or expands a facial recognition database from untargeted scraping. Not when collection is targeted or no facial recognition database is created or expanded.
rules.expression: (system.inputs.facial_images == true and system.inputs.scraped_internet_data == true) and system.scope.untargeted_collection != "no" and system.scope.builds_facial_recognition_database != "no"

rules.description: System uses facial images from public-space surveillance. Not when collection is targeted or no facial recognition database is created or expanded.
rules.expression: (system.inputs.facial_images == true and system.deployment_context.public_space == true) and system.scope.untargeted_collection != "no" and system.scope.builds_facial_recognition_database != "no"

rules.description: System infers emotions in workplace context. Not when only the emotions of customers, patients or the public are inferred, or when medical or safety reasons are declared (amber, see rule_f_medical_or_safety_claimed).
rules.expression: (system.outputs.emotion_inferences == true and system.deployment_context.workplace == true) and system.scope.emotions_of_workers_or_students != "no" and system.scope.medical_or_safety_reasons != "yes"

rules.description: System infers emotions in educational context. Not when only the emotions of people other than students are inferred, or when medical or safety reasons are declared (amber).
rules.expression: (system.outputs.emotion_inferences == true and system.deployment_context.education == true) and system.scope.emotions_of_workers_or_students != "no" and system.scope.medical_or_safety_reasons != "yes"

rules.description: System infers emotions in healthcare context (exception applies, but flag for review). Not when the emotions inferred are not those of workers or students.
rules.expression: (system.outputs.emotion_inferences == true and system.deployment_context.healthcare == true) and system.scope.emotions_of_workers_or_students != "no"

rules.description: System infers emotions in any context. Not when the emotions inferred are not those of workers or students.
rules.expression: (system.outputs.emotion_inferences == true) and system.scope.emotions_of_workers_or_students != "no"

rules.description: Emotion inference on workers or students declared to be put in place for medical or safety reasons. The exception in point (f) is claimed: review the evidence.
rules.expression: system.outputs.emotion_inferences == true and (system.deployment_context.workplace == true or system.deployment_context.education == true) and system.scope.emotions_of_workers_or_students != "no" and system.scope.medical_or_safety_reasons == "yes"

rules.description: System targets minors and produces behaviour predictions. Applies only while the point (b) question in `influence` is not answered.
rules.expression: (targets_population(system, "minors") and system.outputs.behaviour_predictions == true) and system.influence.exploits_vulnerability == "not_answered"

rules.description: System targets persons in vulnerable economic situations. Applies only while the point (b) question in `influence` is not answered.
rules.expression: (targets_population(system, "persons_in_vulnerable_economic_situations")) and system.influence.exploits_vulnerability == "not_answered"

rules.description: System generates freetext output targeting minors: potential exploitation of age-based vulnerability. Applies only while the point (b) question in `influence` is not answered.
rules.expression: (targets_population(system, "minors") and system.outputs.freetext_generations == true) and system.influence.exploits_vulnerability == "not_answered"

rules.description: Declared: the system exploits a vulnerability due to age, disability or a specific social or economic situation, materially distorts behaviour and causes or is reasonably likely to cause significant harm.
rules.expression: system.influence.exploits_vulnerability == "yes" and system.influence.materially_distorts_behaviour == "yes" and system.influence.significant_harm_likely == "yes"

rules.description: Exploitation of a vulnerability is declared or not sure, and neither material distortion nor significant harm is ruled out.
rules.expression: (system.influence.exploits_vulnerability == "yes" or system.influence.exploits_vulnerability == "not_sure") and system.influence.materially_distorts_behaviour != "no" and system.influence.significant_harm_likely != "no" and not (system.influence.exploits_vulnerability == "yes" and system.influence.materially_distorts_behaviour == "yes" and system.influence.significant_harm_likely == "yes")

rules.description: The point (b) question in `influence` is not answered. The verdict comes from population proxies only, with low confidence.
rules.expression: system.influence.exploits_vulnerability == "not_answered"

rules.description: Generating or manipulating realistic intimate or sexually explicit material of identifiable persons is the system's intended purpose, or the deployer's purpose, and consent of the depicted person is not collected and demonstrable.
rules.expression: system.generative_media.intimate_depictions_intended == true and system.generative_media.identifiable_persons == true and system.generative_media.safeguards.consent_demonstrable == false
citations: Art. 113(a), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (applies from 2 December 2026)

rules.description: Realistic intimate or sexually explicit depictions of identifiable persons are a reasonably foreseeable and reproducible outcome, consent of the depicted person is not collected and demonstrable, and the system lacks reasonable and adequate, documented safeguards to prevent them and to correct misuse. Manipulation within Art. 5(1b) is excluded.
rules.expression: system.generative_media.realistic_media_generation == true and system.generative_media.identifiable_persons == true and system.generative_media.intimate_depictions_possible == true and system.generative_media.manipulation_within_1b_only == false and system.generative_media.safeguards.consent_demonstrable == false and not (system.generative_media.safeguards.intimate_output_prevention == true and system.generative_media.safeguards.misuse_correction == true and system.generative_media.safeguards.documented == true)
citations: Art. 113(a), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (applies from 2 December 2026)

rules.description: System generates or manipulates realistic media that can depict identifiable persons, and neither documented prevention of intimate outputs nor documented, demonstrable consent of the depicted person is in place; requires review.
rules.expression: system.generative_media.realistic_media_generation == true and system.generative_media.identifiable_persons == true and not (system.generative_media.safeguards.documented == true and (system.generative_media.safeguards.intimate_output_prevention == true or system.generative_media.safeguards.consent_demonstrable == true))
citations: Art. 113(a), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (applies from 2 December 2026)

rules.description: Sexual material depicting children is a reasonably foreseeable and reproducible outcome of the system, or its intended purpose, and the system lacks measures that reliably prevent it. No consent dimension. Law enforcement and evaluation use under a 'without right' defence is reviewed separately.
rules.expression: system.generative_media.realistic_media_generation == true and system.generative_media.intimate_depictions_possible == true and system.generative_media.minors_depictions_possible == true and system.generative_media.safeguards.csam_prevention == false and system.deployment_context.law_enforcement_use == false
citations: Art. 113(a), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (applies from 2 December 2026)

rules.description: Sexual material depicting children is a possible output and the system is used by law enforcement; a 'without right' defence under national law may apply but requires legal review.
rules.expression: system.generative_media.realistic_media_generation == true and system.generative_media.intimate_depictions_possible == true and system.generative_media.minors_depictions_possible == true and system.deployment_context.law_enforcement_use == true
citations: Art. 113(a), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (applies from 2 December 2026)

rules.description: System generates or manipulates realistic media and its measures against child sexual abuse material are not fully in place and documented; requires review.
rules.expression: system.generative_media.realistic_media_generation == true and not (system.generative_media.safeguards.csam_prevention == true and system.generative_media.safeguards.documented == true)
citations: Art. 113(a), as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (applies from 2 December 2026)

rules.description: System predicts individual criminal risk based on profiling. Not when the system supports a human assessment based on objective and verifiable facts (see rule_d_human_assessment_claimed).
rules.expression: (system.outputs.criminal_risk_predictions == true) and system.scope.human_assessment_on_verifiable_facts != "yes"

rules.description: Crime risk prediction declared to support a human assessment already based on objective and verifiable facts directly linked to a criminal activity. The exclusion in point (d) is claimed: review the evidence.
rules.expression: system.outputs.criminal_risk_predictions == true and system.scope.human_assessment_on_verifiable_facts == "yes"

rules.description: System categorises individuals based on biometric data to infer sensitive attributes (race, political opinions, religious beliefs, sexual orientation). Not when the system only labels or filters lawfully acquired biometric datasets (amber, see rule_g_labelling_claimed).
rules.expression: (system.inputs.biometric == true and system.outputs.sensitive_attribute_classifications == true) and system.scope.dataset_labelling_or_filtering_only != "yes"

rules.description: System uses facial images to infer sensitive attributes. Not when the system only labels or filters lawfully acquired biometric datasets (amber).
rules.expression: (system.inputs.facial_images == true and system.outputs.sensitive_attribute_classifications == true) and system.scope.dataset_labelling_or_filtering_only != "yes"

rules.description: System classifies sensitive attributes from any input; requires review.
rules.expression: system.outputs.sensitive_attribute_classifications == true

rules.description: Biometric categorisation of sensitive attributes declared to be only labelling or filtering of lawfully acquired biometric datasets, or categorising in the area of law enforcement. The carve-out in point (g) is claimed: review the evidence.
rules.expression: (system.inputs.biometric == true or system.inputs.facial_images == true) and system.outputs.sensitive_attribute_classifications == true and system.scope.dataset_labelling_or_filtering_only == "yes"

rules.description: Real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces. Not for a provider that only places the system on the market, not when identification is not remote, not when the purpose is not law enforcement, and amber when an objective in Art. 5(1)(h)(i) to (iii) is declared.
rules.expression: (system.inputs.biometric == true and system.deployment_context.public_space == true and system.deployment_context.real_time_operation == true) and system.scope.role != "provider_only" and system.scope.remote_identification != "no" and system.scope.law_enforcement_purpose != "no" and system.scope.article_5_1_h_objective != "yes"

rules.description: Real-time facial recognition in publicly accessible spaces. Same scope conditions as rule_h_realtime_rbi_public_space.
rules.expression: (system.inputs.facial_images == true and system.deployment_context.public_space == true and system.deployment_context.real_time_operation == true) and system.scope.role != "provider_only" and system.scope.remote_identification != "no" and system.scope.law_enforcement_purpose != "no" and system.scope.article_5_1_h_objective != "yes"

rules.description: Biometric ID in public spaces by law enforcement: a narrow exception exists but requires legal review. Same scope conditions as rule_h_realtime_rbi_public_space.
rules.expression: (system.inputs.biometric == true and system.deployment_context.public_space == true and system.deployment_context.law_enforcement_use == true) and system.scope.role != "provider_only" and system.scope.remote_identification != "no" and system.scope.law_enforcement_purpose != "no"

rules.description: Real-time remote biometric identification in a public space for law enforcement, declared strictly necessary for an objective in Art. 5(1)(h)(i) to (iii). Art. 5(2) and (3) require prior authorisation, a fundamental rights impact assessment and registration: review the evidence.
rules.expression: (system.inputs.biometric == true or system.inputs.facial_images == true) and system.deployment_context.public_space == true and system.deployment_context.real_time_operation == true and system.scope.role != "provider_only" and system.scope.remote_identification != "no" and system.scope.law_enforcement_purpose != "no" and system.scope.article_5_1_h_objective == "yes"
